# AI Platform OpenAPI

Base URL: https://sigrunai.com
API prefix: /v1
Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API Key>

## Docs

- [Quickstart](/zh/index.mdx)
- [Introduction](/zh/api-reference/introduction.mdx)
- [Model catalog](/zh/api-reference/common/model-catalog.mdx): GET /v1/model/catalog
- [Create image](/zh/api-reference/images/create.mdx): POST /v1/images (gpt-image-2)
- [Query image](/zh/api-reference/images/query.mdx): GET /v1/images/{task_id}
- [Query video](/zh/api-reference/common/query.mdx): GET /v1/videos/{task_id}
- [Seedance 2.0 MD](/zh/api-reference/seedance/md/create.mdx): POST /v1/videos · model seedance2.0-md
- [Seedance 2.5 30s](/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create-30s.mdx): POST /v1/videos · model seedance2.5-30s
